Every number under `bundle` was measured on this repository with `npm run build` and then given 5% headroom on a size or one whole unit on a count; none of them is a round number somebody liked the look of. Regenerate with `npm run perf:report -- --update-budgets` and read the diff — a budget that moves up is a decision, not a formality. Numbers under `runtime` are null until someone runs `npm run perf:runtime -- <origin>` with `--update-budgets` against a server they started; a null budget reports as `uncalibrated` and warns, and is never treated as a pass.
